name: Mire of Stone and Earth
body:
School transmutation; Level druid 2, ranger 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range long (400 ft. + 40 ft./level)
Area earth or stone in a 40-ft.-radius spread
Duration 1 min./level (D)
Saving Throw Reflex partial; see text; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

The very earth twists and writhes, creatures that fail their save gain the entangled condition. Creatures that make their save move at only half their base speed in the area. Those that remain in the area must save again at the end of your turn. Creatures that move into the area must save immediately. Those that fail must end their movement and gain the entangled condition. Entangled creatures can attempt to break free as a move action, making a Strength or Escape Artist check. The DC for this check is equal to the DC of the spell. The entire area of effect is considered difficult terrain while the effect lasts.

Creatures with burrow speeds are immune to the effects of mire of stone and earth.
